resources.string: Ask, or say it: calendar, timers, notes, calls
That file could not be opened.
Tetra needs the microphone to hear you.
I did not catch that. Try again.
Make one at console.mistral.ai › API Keys. It is kept encrypted on this phone. What you say, your questions and the tools\' short answers (names, titles) go to Mistral; your files stay here.

Choose Tetra as the digital assistant app. Then hold the power button, swipe up from a bottom corner or hold Home: Tetra listens at once and answers when you stop talking. If your phone keeps the power button for Google, turn on AI Assist in Appearance › App icons and use its icon.
The Mistral key is wrong. Check it in Settings › AI Assist.
Mistral is busy, or the key has no credit left. Try again in a minute.
Add your Mistral API key first: Settings › AI Assist.
Names and words the transcription should spell right, separated by commas. They are sent to Mistral with each recording.
Up to 50 favourites, so that \"call …\" gets the name right. These names are then sent to Mistral with each recording.
Live ended after 20 seconds of silence.
Mistral\'s voices sound natural and cost a little ($0.016 for 1,000 letters read). Mistral has no Greek voice, but its English ones read Greek well. Tap a voice to hear it.
Hello, this is how my answers will sound.
Every AI Assist cost at Mistral\'s list prices, all chats together. Reset starts a new count; the total and the past counts stay.
How long you can stop to think before AI Assist takes what you said (walkie-talkie, the sheet and live).
On the page that opens, tap Digital assistant app (or Default assistant) and choose Tetra. Then holding the power button opens AI Assist.
On Xiaomi also: Settings › Additional settings › Gesture shortcuts › Press and hold the power button › Assistant.
Who people are to you, so you can say “call my sister”. They are saved on your own card in Contacts (Related people), so Contacts and the computer show them too.
Not chosen yet: the assistant asks the first time
On: what you ask goes to Mistral, an AI service on the internet.
Off: nothing goes to any AI service; Tetra works with no internet company at all.
Off, AI Assist and every ✦ button are hidden and no request leaves the device. It is the same on all your devices.
An app switched off is one AI Assist can neither read nor act in, and its AI buttons are hidden.
AI Assist is off (Settings › AI Assist).
